theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lip_good_set_cone_estimate
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (C₃ C₆ : ℝ), 1 ≤ C₃ → 1 ≤ C₆ → ∃ C₈ : ℝ, 0 < C₈ ∧ ∀ (μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k))) (τ : Euclid (n + k) → Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (T₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (σ₀ ε β L : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (τ x).starProjection) μ → 0 < σ₀ → 0 ≤ ε → 0 < β → 0 < L → ε ≤ β * L → (∀ y ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ (3 * σ₀ / 4), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ σ₀ / 2 → ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), (∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall y t, ‖(x - y) - S.starProjection (x - y)‖ ≤ C₃ * ε * t) ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall y (t / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(τ x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C₃ * ε ^ 2 * (t / 2) ^ n)) → (∀ y ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ (3 * σ₀ / 4), ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ σ₀ / 4 → unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n) ≤ 2 * μ (closedBall y t)) → (∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ σ₀, ‖(x - ξ) - T₀.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ C₆ * ε * σ₀) → ∀ y₁ ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ (3 * σ₀ / 4), ∀ y₂ ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ (3 * σ₀ / 4), (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ σ₀ / 2 → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y₁ (t / 2), ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(τ x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T₀.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (β ^ 2 * L ^ 2 * t ^ n)) → ‖(y₂ - y₁) - T₀.starProjection (y₂ - y₁)‖ ≤ C₈ * β * L * ‖y₂ - y₁‖
